caption: notify
doc: Exibe uma mensagem de notificação toast.

AAi.caption: message
AAi.doc: The text displayed inside the notification.  Example:  Lead successfully created.
AAi.name: message

AAl.caption: duration
AAl.doc: Display time in milliseconds.  Examples:  2000 = 2 seconds 4000 = 4 seconds 6000 = 6 seconds
AAl.name: duration

AAn.caption: show_icon
AAn.doc: When enabled, the notification displays an icon before the message.  Yes No
AAn.name: show_icon

AAo.caption: custom_icon
AAo.doc: Displays a custom emoji instead of the default icon.  Examples:  🏠 🚀 📧 ⭐  Leave empty to use the default icon for the selected type.Success → 👍  Error → ❌  Blank → ℹ️  Loading → ⏳
AAo.name: custom_icon

AAq.caption: position
AAq.doc: Defines where the toast notification will be displayed on the screen.  Available options:  • Top - Displays the notification at the top of the screen. • Center - Displays the notification in the center of the screen. • Bottom - Displays the notification at the bottom of the screen.  Default: Top
AAq.name: position
